title: Looking for a Free Microsoft 365 Replacement? Try This Program - CNET
summary: LIbreOffice’s Calc has similar functionality to Microsoft’s Excel. Google also offers office productivity apps, like Docs and Sheets, for free, but unlike LibreOffice, it requires a Google account to use it, meaning you’re handing over some personal data.
